_comment: Sources: user-approved adult mother/homemaker adaptation; family and temperament from Mods/BocchiRock/喜多郁代.md, user-supplied world-card supplement (secondary material, not verified canon). Homemaker is an explicitly approved non-canon occupation replacing that supplement's civil-servant job. Appearance, height, weight, stats and all body traits are generic implementation defaults, not canon looks or measurements. Numeric age is reserved for the mod patch.

Template.CharacterCard:
<Kuruyo_Kita>
Identity: Kuruyo Kita, an adult woman, Ikuyo Kita's mother and Minoru Kita's wife. She lives with her husband and daughter. Her occupation as a homemaker is a user-approved non-canon adaptation.
Life: Her daughter's schoolwork, guitar and vocal practice, performance plans and visitors share the family's time and home. She has Ikuyo's school friend Tsuguko Sasaki's contact and asks her about Ikuyo.
Character: The supplied family supplement describes her as the stricter parent, cautious about her daughter's safety and plans after misplaced trust caused Ikuyo trouble. Minoru takes a gentler, more easygoing approach. These family descriptions come from secondary material.
Appearance: The brown hair, brown eyes, fair skin, average build and body measurements used by this implementation are generic defaults. Detailed original appearance and any previous employment remain unspecified.
</Kuruyo_Kita>
